risks.risk: The unit may be a generic or 'off-brand' part rather than a genuine Bosch for the specific Volkswagen model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the VIN plate or the manufacturer's identification plate on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic Bosch part for Volkswagen

risks.risk: The unit may be non-functional or have a faulty ECU (Electronic Control Unit).
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on and successfully communicating with a diagnostic scanner.

risks.risk: The wiring harness may be damaged or have loose connections.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the resistance across the harness pins.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full harness replacement

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the VIN plate or identification plate on the unit.
Video of the unit powered on and communicating with a diagnostic scanner.
Photo of the wiring harness with a multimeter test showing no open circuits.
